entities.name: Johanna Maria Bonomo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Giovanna Maria Bonomo was a Catholic nun who was a professed member of the Benedictines. She was ridiculed for her dedication and her experiences as some believed them to be heretical or a need for attention.
